quest.title: Plant Research: Nocturnal Blossoms
quest.description: Nocturnal Blossoms are also growing north of Nasha Town, in areas where kuuvahki levels are lower...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Nocturnal Blossom x2

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Linnea quickly makes the necessary preparations for the investigation...

talks.objective: Head to the designated location to investigate

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (There seems to be something nearby worth examining. <color=#FFCC33FF>Linnea</color>, with her deep knowledge of the local ecology, might find something useful...)

dialogues.speaker: Vesa
dialogues.text: You're being mean, Metta! I just wanted you to have fun on your adventure... Why do you have to say things like that, hmph...

dialogues.speaker: Metta
dialogues.text: If you don't stop acting on every little whim, others are going to get frustrated with you too.

dialogues.speaker: Vesa
dialogues.text: I was not acting on a whim! I—I have my own plans too...

dialogues.speaker: Metta
dialogues.text: Wow, plans, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Vesa
dialogues.text: Ugh... you're dismissing me again. I'm not talking to you anymore! Even if you regret it later, it'll be too late!

dialogues.speaker: Vesa
dialogues.text: ...Ah, Linnea! Metta was being—

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: As Vesa fumbles through the story of what happened, it becomes clear that it was just a typical little quarrel among kids...

dialogues.speaker: Metta
dialogues.text: No matter how I look at it, I wasn't the one at fault, right?

dialogues.speaker: Vesa
dialogues.text: Then... I wasn't wrong either! Big Sis Linnea...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Hmm... sometimes these things just happen. No one's really at fault, but things still don't turn out the way we want them to.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Oh, it's like the story of the two sisters among the Frostmoon Scions that the Nocturnal Blossom represents.

dialogues.speaker: Vesa
dialogues.text: Huh? The story of two sisters?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Yes. I've heard that there were once two sisters among the Frostmoon Scions. They were very different in personality, like the Nocturnal Blossom — one red, one blue.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Both sisters did what they believed was right, but because of that, they went their separate ways.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: It's said the younger sister never forgave her elder sister for leaving her behind, even though the elder went on to save countless lives... In the end, up until they died, the two never saw each other again.

dialogues.speaker: Metta
dialogues.text: Oh... I didn't know the Frostmoon Scions had stories like that...

dialogues.speaker: Vesa
dialogues.text: Me neither...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Hmm... I heard it from a traveling bard. Maybe there's some embellishment in it...

dialogues.speaker: Metta
dialogues.text: Ah, so it's a made-up story.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Well, even if the story isn't entirely true, the lesson it carries is still sound, right?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Neither of them thought they were in the wrong. Both were certain their own choice was the right one, but their choices meant they lost each other forever.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: If proving you're right means losing a friend... what would you choose?

dialogues.speaker: Metta
dialogues.text: Ah... actually, a few spontaneous little detours on an adventure aren't so bad...

dialogues.speaker: Vesa
dialogues.text: ...Yeah! Come to think of it, the time Metta spends adventuring with me is precious. If I keep changing my mind, we might not get to enjoy anything at all...

dialogues.speaker: Vesa
dialogues.text: I... I'll plan things better next time!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Hehe, I'm glad to see you two getting along again.

dialogues.speaker: Metta
dialogues.text: Next time Vesa and I go on an adventure, we'll bring any unusual stones we find back to Speranza.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Sounds good! Thanks in advance, then.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Oh, Nocturnal Blossoms are growing here as well. I'll gather some.
